meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 当 Codex 成功修改文件后,会自动检查代码中的注释;若检查器发出警告,它会先修复或解释被标记的注释,再继续后续操作。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后触发。

say.text: 修复刚才被注释检查器标记的问题。
解释一下这条注释为什么被警告。
say.note: 它会说明原因并给出建议。

say.text: 改这段代码时顺便检查注释质量。
say.note: 若发现警告会先告知你。

howto.what_en: After a successful file edit, Codex automatically runs a comment checker. If it warns about a comment, it must fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggers after successful edit-like operations such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc.

say_en.text: Fix the comment issues just flagged.
Explain why this comment was warned.
say_en.note: It will give reasons and suggestions.

say_en.text: When editing this code, also check comment quality.
